title: net1 v7's traffic head refitted on data from the policies that read it (one round of aggregation)
description: Beside the fixed rule, net1 v7's traffic head (exp-traffic-head-v7-300) calls a Cubic flow that started first copies in 7% to 9% of steps at every age; driving round 33's net2 (net2-r33h-s1), it does so in 39% of steps 5 to 10 s into the episode and about 20% after (exp-traffic-head-cubic-first-305). The policy that reads the head moves its measurements off the head's training data, which came from the fixed rule alone. This gathers the data from the policies that read it: round 33's seed 1 at iteration 59 with its belief in copies from the head (net2-r33h-s1) and round 29's seed 1 with both beliefs from it (net2-v7hp-s1) as the observed flow on the training links (campaign seed 1, 30 s) under the new family's conditions (a Cubic flow from 0 s among them) and as 1, 2 and 4 copies, steps kept, as run 300 did with the fixed rule. experiments/traffic_head.py fits the head on run 300's data and this together (agg/traffic_head.pt, copied to traffic_head.pt) and reports its balanced accuracy on training links held out of the fit. It is scored on run 305's validation-link data, beside the fixed rule and in the closed loop (val-NAME), and the old head on this run's closed-loop training data (val-old). Reading, stated before the results: the refit fixes the closed loop's misfire if, on run 305's closed-loop data, it calls the Cubic flow copies in at most 10% of steps at every age, while keeping a balanced accuracy of at least 0.85 beside the fixed rule.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); H="$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; echo "62043107ace9c7c3c913124f42d26023474ec6108cc59d959475da6bd57820be  $H" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; d="$OUT/runs/r29-s1"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s1.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s1.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" net2-v7hp-s1 "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H" --traffic-p; r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s1"; e="$OUT/runs/r33-s1"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/traffic_head.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; cmp "$e/traffic_head.pt" "$H"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" net2-r33h-s1 "$e" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"; P=(--policy "net2-r33h-s1=$OUT/p/net2-r33h-s1.onnx" --policy "net2-v7hp-s1=$OUT/p/net2-v7hp-s1.onnx"); uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-new" --split train --family new --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-new/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-new"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split train --duration-ms 30000 --seed 1 --n 1 2 4 --stock "" "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: N="$IN/t/net1-v7.pt"; mkdir -p "$OUT/agg"; for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do ln -s "../$(basename "$c")" "$OUT/agg/"; done; for c in "$IN/old"/c-*; do ln -s "$c" "$OUT/agg/c-old-${c##*/c-}"; done; uv run python experiments/traffic_head.py "$OUT/agg" "$N"; cp "$OUT/agg/traffic_head.pt" "$OUT/traffic_head.pt"; for a in rule-v7 net2-r33h-s1; do mkdir -p "$OUT/val-$a"; uv run python experiments/traffic_head_val.py "$OUT/val-$a" "$IN/d/obs-$a" "$N" "$OUT/traffic_head.pt"; done; mkdir -p "$OUT/val-old"; uv run python experiments/traffic_head_val.py "$OUT/val-old" "$OUT" "$N" "$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; { echo "## The refitted head, on run 300 and this run's training links"; echo; cat "$OUT/agg/summary.md"; echo; for a in rule-v7 net2-r33h-s1; do echo "## The refitted head on run 305, observed flow $a"; echo; cat "$OUT/val-$a/summary.md"; echo; done; echo "## The old head on this run's closed-loop training data"; echo; cat "$OUT/val-old/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.md"; rm "$OUT"/agg/c-*; sha256sum "$OUT/traffic_head.pt"
